text: Introduction This project is undertaken by School of Mechatronics Engineering of WUT. And the school has majors of Mechanical Engineering and Automation, Monitoring Technology and Equipment, Process Equipment and Control Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Packaging Engineering, Institute of Tribology, Digital Manufacture Center and R&D Center of Building Materials. The teachers are mainly professors who graduate from distinguished universities in Europe and USA, and they are all experienced in teaching and supervising international students. Directions of Cultivation Advanced engineering and technical personnel who can make quantitative analysis and optimization designing in terms of systems on problems of actual engineering and management in technical management, production planning, operations management and many other aspects.Bachelors' Degree for Class Formed Only by International Students are required to have as least 12 students in one program.
